mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the membrane pump was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects ATP use to movement from lower to higher particle concentration, while retaining the sugar transporter for comparison.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen was the least illuminating passage: the arrows show it meeting fuel processing at the mitochondrion but do not explain its role.

surprise.text: The first result clarified that glucose is split in the cell fluid before smaller fuel molecules reach the mitochondrion.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the oxygen step's connection to ATP production remained unexplained. Each decision also had only one offered combination, so there was little opportunity to make meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it developed these relationships further, though the single-option sequence offered little decision-making. The planned pictures appear useful, but this playthrough cannot establish student comprehension or enjoyment.
